name: Draw.io
description: Create and edit draw.io flowcharts, architecture diagrams, and multi-page diagrams entirely offline in Orca, with an infinite canvas, collapsible sidebar, popular vector shape libraries, undo and redo, automatic synchronization, and high-resolution PNG and SVG clipboard copying.
